description: Run a Python 3 program (standard library only) in your workspace and return what it prints; the last line is always [exit code N], your program's exit code (non-zero there is your program's result, not a tool error). To measure time, print time.perf_counter yourself. Timeout: CommandFailed. See memory node errors.

timeout_s.description: most seconds to run (default 60, at most 300); past it the process group is stopped and the call fails
